title: Taiwanese American Student Association at Penn State
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association at Penn State (TASA) is a student organization at Pennsylvania State University’s University Park campus dedicated to connecting students with Taiwanese backgrounds and serving as a cultural and social home for Taiwanese and Taiwanese American students. Known on social media as TASA @ Penn State, the organization operates under its Chinese name 賓州州立大學台灣同學會 and maintains an active presence on both Instagram and Facebook.

TASA hosts a range of cultural and social programming throughout the academic year. Among its signature events is an Annual Gala—a celebration featuring cultural performances, collaborations with other student organizations, and participation from special guests. The organization has also been documented encouraging members to attend broader Penn State community events such as THON and football games, with the stated goal of helping Taiwanese and international students engage with campus life. Past leadership described TASA’s purpose as assisting and sponsoring native and Taiwanese American students in adapting to college life at Penn State, while also welcoming members from diverse backgrounds.
